description.value: Co-op Tappen Food Store is a locally-owned, member-governed co-operative grocery on the Trans-Canada Highway in the small community of Tappen, BC, part of the Federated Co-operatives network. Non-members are explicitly welcome to shop alongside member-owners. Its Trans-Canada location makes it a natural resupply point for cyclists travelling through the Shuswap corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Tappen Co-op is a real, operating co-operative; the FAQ and subpages loaded successfully and the site's own text states it is a 'locally-owned co-operative serving Tappen,' with no indication of closure. The store name 'Food Store' combined with the Co-op network FAQ describing 'Food Stores' as a distinct Co-op retail category supports a basic groceries classification. No specific amenity details such as bike parking, water access, or washrooms appear anywhere in the fetched website content, so those fields are left null.
concerns: Website content is predominantly CMS template boilerplate with minimal store-specific information; no amenity details could be verified from the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, publicly accessible co-operative food store on the Trans-Canada Highway with an active website confirming ongoing operations.

wow_evidence: locally-owned co-operative serving Tappen… part of the Federated Co-operatives network
